name: After § 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 12b. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to introduce a European strategy for moratoria on the closure of industrial production sites that are necessary for the industrial transition and the industrial fabric of the Union; stresses that moratoria are essential to prevent irreversible job losses and skills losses, preserve industrial employment and counteract the trend of deindustrialisation in Europe;
